Subject: Request: Executive approval for renewal concession in exchange for published case study and logo usage

Team,

Quick escalation — Acme Systems (renewal due Dec) is signaling they will sign provided we give a contract concession tied to marketing/publicity. Summary:
- ARR: $1.2M annual renewal (current term)
- Customer asks: public case study, 12-month logo use, short video testimonial (30s).
- Ask from customer: 30% renewal discount + waived first-month fees for new integration work.

I've attached a draft case study and the proposed publicity snippet for review. Proposed ask from our side (what I’d recommend):
- Max discount: 25% on renewal for 12 months (applied as one-time credit)
- $50k onboarding credit for integration work (one-time)
- Customer provides final sign-off on case study script and logo artwork prior to publication
- Non-exclusive, 12-month publicity rights, Redwood to own the published case study asset

Why this matters: this is a strategic Winter renewal (longstanding reference), large logo in FinTech vertical, and they’re willing to be a customer reference (sales + GTM value).

Requesting: executive greenlight for a concession up to the proposed levels above and confirmation that legal can accept the publicity terms below (no indemnity, prior review). Need a quick decision by EOD Tuesday (11/3) so we can meet Acme’s procurement timeline.

Attachments: draft_case_study_acme_v1.pdf, proposed_publicity_snippet.txt

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive approval for renewal concession in exchange for published case study and logo usage

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the draft publicity snippet and have redlines. Primary legal flags:
- No indemnity from Redwood for customer statements; we cannot accept broad customer editorial control that binds our statement.
- Limit publicity rights to non-exclusive, 12 months, require prior factual accuracy review (customer may request edits but Redwood retains final approval on messaging about product capabilities).
- Include a narrow publicity release (logo + short quote) rather than granting rights to derivative works or video edits beyond what's agreed.
- Remove any language that requires Redwood to indemnify or provide unlimited rights.

Attaching legal_redlines_publicity_terms.docx (highlights included). If we proceed with 25% + $50k credit, legal is comfortable with the above constraints and with the PR embargo until the signed renewal is in DocuSign.

Laura
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
